Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the city where Pope Pius XI died. While Pope Pius XI died in Vatican City, the specific post titled "Governor of the City" (Governatore della Città di Roma) historically refers to the capital of Italy, Rome. Vatican City has never had a post with this specific title; its governance is handled by the Governor of Vatican City State or the Prefect of the Papal Household. By focusing the search on Vatican City first and failing to recognize that the standard historical title "Governor of the City" applies to Rome, the Planner directed the WebSurfer down an unproductive path that never yielded the correct answer (1952, the year the Governor of Rome post was abolished/replaced). The correct approach should have been to search for "Governor of Rome" immediately after confirming the author's death location context, as Vatican City is an enclave within Rome and the specific title points to the larger city.
